#### 1. complement component 4a deficiency  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.405)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-166663)

**Proposed mechanism:** C4A (HGNC:2077) —DISRUPTS→ Complement System Activation (GO:0006955); Complement System Activation (GO:0006955) —LEADS_TO→ Immune dysregulation (HP:0002715); Complement System Activation (GO:0006955) —LEADS_TO→ Increased susceptibility to infections (HP:0002719). Loss-of-function mutations or deficiency in C4A (HGNC:2077) disrupt the classical and lectin pathways of the complement system (GO:0006955). This dysregulation can lead to immune dysregulation (HP:0002715) and increased susceptibility to infections (HP:0002719).

**How to falsify it:** Demonstration that C4A variants associated with MONDO:0013467 do not impair complement system function, or that complement component 4a deficiency (MONDO:0013721) is not associated with impaired complement function. _(variant: rs777037665)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding this overlap could inform therapeutic strategies targeting the complement system for both conditions, potentially involving complement inhibition or modulation to restore immune homeostasis.

#### 2. 3MC syndrome 2  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.397)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-166662, Reactome:R-HSA-166663)

**Proposed mechanism:** FCN3 (HGNC:27460) —DISRUPTS→ Ficolin-3 mediated complement activation (REACT:R-HSA-1125508); COLEC11 (HGNC:27461) —DISRUPTS→ Collectin-11 mediated complement activation (REACT:R-HSA-1125508); Ficolin-3 mediated complement activation (REACT:R-HSA-1125508) —DECREASES→ Complement system activation (REACT:R-HSA-1125508); Collectin-11 mediated complement activation (REACT:R-HSA-1125508) —DECREASES→ Complement system activation (REACT:R-HSA-1125508); Complement system activation (REACT:R-HSA-1125508) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal cranial suture development (HP:0034016); Complement system activation (REACT:R-HSA-1125508) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability, severe (HP:0010864). Loss-of-function mutations in FCN3 (causing MONDO:0013467) and COLEC11 (causing MONDO:0009927) both impair the lectin pathway of complement activation. The convergence on the general complement system activation pathway (n5) leads to downstream phenotypic consequences common to both diseases, such as abnormal cranial suture development and intellectual disability.

**How to falsify it:** Demonstration that variants in FCN3 or COLEC11 do not impact complement activation, or that the complement system is not involved in the pathogenesis of either disease. _(variant: High frequency (>1%) of pathogenic variants in FCN3 or COLEC11 in gnomAD.)_

**Why it matters:** Targeting the complement system or its upstream activators like Ficolin-3 and Collectin-11 could offer therapeutic avenues for both MONDO:0013467 and MONDO:0009927, particularly for developmental aspects. Understanding the specific downstream effects of complement dysregulation in each disease will be crucial for developing targeted therapies.
